units.locator: The Central Federal District
units.text: developing the supply-side economy, including high-technology production in pharmacology and biomedicine, microelectronics and nuclear energy, through contracts with reciprocal investment obligations (offset contracts) and the creation of high-productivity jobs;
units.label: The Central Federal District · “developing the supply-side economy, including high-technology…”

units.locator: The Central Federal District
units.text: creating education and production centers (clusters), including in the chemical industry, machinery manufacturing, the fuel and energy complex, radioelectronics, construction, agriculture and information technology.
units.label: The Central Federal District · “creating education and production centers (clusters), including…”

units.locator: The Southern Federal District
units.text: The Southern Federal District
units.label: The Southern Federal District

units.locator: The Southern Federal District
units.text: The main development directions for the Southern Federal District include:
units.label: The Southern Federal District · “The main development directions for the Southern Federal…”

units.locator: The Southern Federal District
units.text: developing rail, road and inland water transport infrastructure in the Azov–Black Sea region, including by developing infrastructure of the North–South International Transport Corridor and bringing the Volgograd–Astrakhan and Astrakhan–state border with the Republic of Kazakhstan roads up to regulatory standards, creating and developing near and distant road approaches to the Crimean Bridge, developing exits to the Azov and Black Sea coasts, and increasing the throughput capacity of railway approaches to Azov–Black Sea Basin ports;
units.label: The Southern Federal District · “developing rail, road and inland water transport infrastructure…”

units.locator: The Southern Federal District
units.text: developing machinery manufacturing, metallurgy, shipbuilding and ship repair, including through industrial clusters;
units.label: The Southern Federal District · “developing machinery manufacturing, metallurgy, shipbuilding…”

units.locator: The Southern Federal District
units.text: providing infrastructure to meet growing demand for domestic tourism, including by increasing accommodation capacity in accordance with the interregional territorial and spatial tourism planning scheme for the Crimean Peninsula;
units.label: The Southern Federal District · “providing infrastructure to meet growing demand for domestic…”

units.locator: The Southern Federal District
units.text: reducing energy shortages and removing grid constraints, including by constructing new generating capacity in the southwestern part of the South Interconnected Power System following competitive capacity selection for new generating facilities;
units.label: The Southern Federal District · “reducing energy shortages and removing grid constraints,…”

units.locator: The Southern Federal District
units.text: modernizing and constructing utilities systems and treatment facilities in light of growing tourist flows;
units.label: The Southern Federal District · “modernizing and constructing utilities systems and treatment…”

units.locator: The Southern Federal District
units.text: developing the agro-industrial complex as a key driver of the Southern Federal District’s economy, including through digitalization of agricultural production, the use of unmanned aerial systems and preservation of the fertility of agricultural land in use;
units.label: The Southern Federal District · “developing the agro-industrial complex as a key driver of the…”

units.locator: The Southern Federal District
units.text: synchronizing development of the constituent entities of the Southern Federal District and the new constituent entities of the Russian Federation, including by ensuring unified approaches to planning tourism, industry, energy, transport and utilities infrastructure as part of development of the Azov Sea region.
units.label: The Southern Federal District · “synchronizing development of the constituent entities of the…”

units.locator: New Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: New Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation
units.label: New Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation

units.locator: New Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: The main development directions for the new constituent entities of the Russian Federation are:
units.label: New Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation · “The main development directions for the new constituent…”

units.locator: New Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: integrating the new constituent entities of the Russian Federation into the country’s common economic space, including the unified core transport network, and ensuring a quality of life no lower than the Russian average, taking account of the state program of the Russian Federation “Restoration and Socioeconomic Development of the Donetsk People’s Republic, the Lugansk People’s Republic, Zaporozhye Oblast and Kherson Oblast”; this includes creating a unified economic space in the Azov Sea region by 2028 through transport connectivity between the new constituent entities of the Russian Federation, the Republic of Crimea and the city of Sevastopol and the constituent entities of the Russian Federation on the Sea of Azov and other constituent entities bordering the aforementioned territories, namely Krasnodar Krai and Belgorod, Voronezh and Rostov Oblasts;
units.label: New Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation · “integrating the new constituent entities of the Russian…”

units.locator: New Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: restoring housing and utilities, transport, social, innovation and other infrastructure, including restoring and ensuring uninterrupted operation of electricity grid infrastructure and providing operating organizations with emergency stocks of materials and equipment to ensure stable electricity supply to all categories of consumers;
units.label: New Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation · “restoring housing and utilities, transport, social, innovation…”

units.locator: New Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: reducing shortages of qualified personnel through network-based educational programs aligned with promising economic sectors of the new constituent entities of the Russian Federation, taking account of their authorities’ assessment of the need for state-funded study places and providing special reduced-rate lending terms for applicants;
units.label: New Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation · “reducing shortages of qualified personnel through network-based…”

units.locator: New Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: developing industry, including metallurgy and machinery manufacturing, among other things by leasing promising coal industry enterprises to investors and decommissioning inefficient and loss-making enterprises with difficult mining and geological conditions and/or hazards from sudden outbursts and gas, which carry high risks of accidents and incidents;
units.label: New Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation · “developing industry, including metallurgy and machinery…”

units.locator: New Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: developing the Azov Sea tourism and recreation cluster and resorts on the Black Sea coast, including priority forms of tourism: health-resort, water-based, yachting, agricultural and automotive tourism;
units.label: New Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation · “developing the Azov Sea tourism and recreation cluster and…”

units.locator: New Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: developing agriculture.
units.label: New Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation · “developing agriculture.”

units.locator: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation
units.text: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation
units.label: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation

units.locator: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation
units.text: Risks to the spatial development of the Russian Federation are associated with the continuation of trends through 2030, including accelerated concentration of economic activity and population in urban agglomerations, deterioration of the demographic situation and worsening personnel shortages.
units.label: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation · “Risks to the spatial development of the Russian Federation are…”

units.locator: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation
units.text: Along with a possible deterioration in external economic conditions, spatial development risks will complicate achievement of both the national goals and spatial development target indicators.
units.label: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation · “Along with a possible deterioration in external economic…”

units.locator: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation
units.text: To monitor and minimize these risks, measures in spatial development must be coordinated, trends in spatial development target indicators and performance of the Strategy’s tasks must be monitored, and, where necessary, the Strategy and its implementation action plan must be updated in a timely manner.
units.label: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation · “To monitor and minimize these risks, measures in spatial…”

units.locator: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation
units.text: Taking account of these risks, the Strategy provides for 2 scenarios of spatial development of the Russian Federation: inertial and target.
units.label: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation · “Taking account of these risks, the Strategy provides for 2…”

units.locator: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation
units.text: The inertial scenario of spatial development of the Russian Federation assumes continuation of established spatial development trends, including the settlement system and the territorial organization of the economy.
units.label: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation · “The inertial scenario of spatial development of the Russian…”

units.locator: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation
units.text: The target scenario of spatial development of the Russian Federation assumes achievement of the spatial development goal through performance of the spatial development tasks provided for in the Strategy.
units.label: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation · “The target scenario of spatial development of the Russian…”

units.locator: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation
units.text: Progress in performing those tasks is assessed through the system of spatial development target indicators.
units.label: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation · “Progress in performing those tasks is assessed through the…”

units.locator: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation
units.text: Spatial development target indicators have been calculated in accordance with the inertial and target scenarios provided for in Annex No. 1 to the Strategy.
units.label: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation · “Spatial development target indicators have been calculated in…”

units.locator: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation
units.text: The main mechanisms for implementing the Strategy provided for in Section XI of the Strategy are used to achieve the spatial development target indicators.
units.label: X. Scenarios and Risks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation · “The main mechanisms for implementing the Strategy provided for…”

units.locator: XI. Priority Mechanisms for Implementing the Strategy
units.text: XI. Priority Mechanisms for Implementing the Strategy
units.label: XI. Priority Mechanisms for Implementing the Strategy

units.locator: XI. Priority Mechanisms for Implementing the Strategy
units.text: To identify priority mechanisms for implementing the Strategy, the results of spatial development mechanisms of the Russian Federation used before 2025 have been analyzed.
units.label: XI. Priority Mechanisms for Implementing the Strategy · “To identify priority mechanisms for implementing the Strategy,…”

units.locator: XI. Priority Mechanisms for Implementing the Strategy
units.text: Combined use of those mechanisms, including state programs, national projects, individual development programs for constituent entities of the Russian Federation and infrastructure budget loans, has achieved significant results in addressing spatial development tasks of the Russian Federation, including overcoming infrastructure constraints of federal significance, reducing interregional socioeconomic disparities and ensuring national security through the development of geostrategic territories of the Russian Federation.
units.label: XI. Priority Mechanisms for Implementing the Strategy · “Combined use of those mechanisms, including state programs,…”

units.locator: XI. Priority Mechanisms for Implementing the Strategy
units.text: The spatial development mechanisms of the Russian Federation used before 2025 remain relevant. At the same time, to address the spatial development tasks of the Russian Federation defined by the Strategy, the spatial development priorities reflected in the Strategy and the need to concentrate resources on developing anchor settlements must be enshrined in regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and of its constituent entities under which national projects, state programs and other infrastructure development instruments are implemented.
units.label: XI. Priority Mechanisms for Implementing the Strategy · “The spatial development mechanisms of the Russian Federation…”

units.locator: Action Plan for Implementing the Strategy and Stages of Its Implementation
units.text: Action Plan for Implementing the Strategy and Stages of Its Implementation
units.label: Action Plan for Implementing the Strategy and Stages of Its Implementation

units.locator: Action Plan for Implementing the Strategy and Stages of Its Implementation
units.text: The action plan for implementing the Strategy is developed for the period of its implementation and contains a list of the most important socially significant measures, with implementation deadlines and responsible implementers. The Strategy is implemented in a single stage.
units.label: Action Plan for Implementing the Strategy and Stages of Its Implementation · “The action plan for implementing the Strategy is developed for…”

units.locator: Action Plan for Implementing the Strategy and Stages of Its Implementation
units.text: The plan’s measures are intended to ensure that spatial development principles and tasks are taken into account in implementing state policy, including in preparing and implementing strategic planning documents of the Russian Federation, other program documents and state support mechanisms, including through corresponding amendments to regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and its constituent entities.
units.label: Action Plan for Implementing the Strategy and Stages of Its Implementation · “The plan’s measures are intended to ensure that spatial…”

units.locator: Strategic Planning Documents and Individual Development Programs
units.text: Strategic Planning Documents and Individual Development Programs
units.label: Strategic Planning Documents and Individual Development Programs

units.locator: Strategic Planning Documents and Individual Development Programs
units.text: Fulfilling the Strategy’s goal and tasks and achieving spatial development target indicators will require alignment with the Strategy of other documents aimed at the country’s socioeconomic development, including sectoral strategic planning documents, national projects and state programs.
units.label: Strategic Planning Documents and Individual Development Programs · “Fulfilling the Strategy’s goal and tasks and achieving spatial…”

units.locator: Strategic Planning Documents and Individual Development Programs
units.text: The Strategy’s provisions are taken into account in developing:
units.label: Strategic Planning Documents and Individual Development Programs · “The Strategy’s provisions are taken into account in developing:”

units.locator: Strategic Planning Documents and Individual Development Programs
units.text: strategic planning documents of the Russian Federation or its constituent entities, including sectoral strategic planning documents of the Russian Federation, socioeconomic development strategies of the federal districts and constituent entities of the Russian Federation, national projects and state programs, including the rules established in them for granting subsidies and other earmarked interbudgetary transfers;
units.label: Strategic Planning Documents and Individual Development Programs · “strategic planning documents of the Russian Federation or its…”

units.locator: Strategic Planning Documents and Individual Development Programs
units.text: strategic planning documents for geostrategic territories of the Russian Federation, including integrated state programs developed for those territories;
units.label: Strategic Planning Documents and Individual Development Programs · “strategic planning documents for geostrategic territories of…”

units.locator: Strategic Planning Documents and Individual Development Programs
units.text: individual development programs for constituent entities of the Russian Federation with low socioeconomic development levels, territorial development master plans, long-term socioeconomic development plans for anchor settlements, including urban agglomerations, and other documents aimed at territories’ socioeconomic development.
units.label: Strategic Planning Documents and Individual Development Programs · “individual development programs for constituent entities of the…”

units.locator: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements
units.text: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements
units.label: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements

units.locator: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements
units.text: Priority support for the development of anchor settlements is provided on the basis of the unified list of anchor settlements.
units.label: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements · “Priority support for the development of anchor settlements is…”

units.locator: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements
units.text: The classification of settlements identifies anchor settlements with different primary functions according to their role in achieving spatial development priorities and determines the main tasks for supporting their development.
units.label: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements · “The classification of settlements identifies anchor settlements…”

units.locator: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements
units.text: The unified list of anchor settlements is intended to concentrate instruments and resources to help achieve the national goals, including reducing disparities in the socioeconomic development of the country’s territories.
units.label: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements · “The unified list of anchor settlements is intended to…”

units.locator: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements
units.text: Anchor settlements where new investment projects with a substantial impact on the economy are being implemented are regarded in the Strategy as prospective centers of economic growth.
units.label: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements · “Anchor settlements where new investment projects with a…”

units.locator: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements
units.text: The main development tasks for anchor settlements are:
units.label: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements · “The main development tasks for anchor settlements are:”

units.locator: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements
units.text: for settlements where new investment projects with a substantial impact on the economy are being implemented: advance development of transport and energy infrastructure, including deployment of energy-saving and energy-efficient technologies, to support investment projects; housing construction and the creation of utilities and social infrastructure, including to attract personnel; and the use of territorial development instruments, including to support high-technology sectors and investment projects important for achieving the technological sovereignty of the Russian Federation;
units.label: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements · “for settlements where new investment projects with a…”

units.locator: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements
units.text: for settlements ensuring the national security of the Russian Federation and serving critical infrastructure, and for science cities: ensuring a living environment of sufficient quality to retain and increase the population, including through infrastructure development instruments aimed at diversifying the economies of the territories concerned, alongside developing cooperation chains needed to improve the resilience and operating efficiency of the enterprises and other facilities that give the settlements their strategic importance; and supporting higher and secondary vocational education infrastructure and scientific and technological projects in the settlements;
units.label: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements · “for settlements ensuring the national security of the Russian…”

units.locator: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements
units.text: for settlements within urban agglomerations and administrative centers of constituent entities of the Russian Federation outside urban agglomerations: improving economic efficiency through concentration (densification) of economic activity and development of agglomeration and interregional economic ties; ensuring scientific, technological and innovative development; providing investment projects with transport and social infrastructure; creating conditions for active housing construction; and improving the reliability of electricity supply to consumers, including through infrastructure-based territorial development instruments aimed at bringing former industrial sites into economic use, taking account of historically established economic specialization;
units.label: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements · “for settlements within urban agglomerations and administrative…”

units.locator: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements
units.text: for settlements serving as the main centers providing medical care, education and cultural services and meeting other needs of residents of adjacent territories: developing the relevant infrastructure with account taken of the population of the adjacent territory, in order to reduce population outflows from small and medium-sized cities and rural settlements.
units.label: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements · “for settlements serving as the main centers providing medical…”

units.locator: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements
units.text: The unified list of anchor settlements identifies anchor settlements, including single-industry towns, at risk of socioeconomic deterioration, including rising unemployment and the closure or liquidation of major enterprises, including city-forming enterprises, caused by unlawful unilateral restrictive measures by unfriendly states, declining demand for the products of major enterprises or other adverse factors.
units.label: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements · “The unified list of anchor settlements identifies anchor…”

units.locator: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements
units.text: The socioeconomic situation of anchor settlements is monitored to identify settlements at risk of socioeconomic deterioration and develop measures to manage those risks.
units.label: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements · “The socioeconomic situation of anchor settlements is monitored…”

units.locator: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements
units.text: Risk management measures may include remedying damage when production facilities close, assistance with relocation or retraining, encouraging diversification of settlements’ economies and improving investment attractiveness.
units.label: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements · “Risk management measures may include remedying damage when…”

units.locator: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements
units.text: Anchor settlements receive support measures on a priority basis, taking account of their main development tasks. Provisions giving priority to financing measures (projects) in anchor settlements are integrated into the processes of preparing state programs, granting subsidies from the federal budget and providing other support measures.
units.label: The Unified List of Anchor Settlements · “Anchor settlements receive support measures on a priority…”

units.locator: Territorial Planning
units.text: Territorial Planning
units.label: Territorial Planning

units.locator: Territorial Planning
units.text: Territorial planning is a key mechanism for implementing the Strategy’s priorities, ensuring alignment of budget expenditure with spatial development priorities, including linkage to the development tasks of anchor settlements and geostrategic territories of the Russian Federation and the main development directions of the federal districts of the Russian Federation and the Arctic Zone of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Territorial Planning · “Territorial planning is a key mechanism for implementing the…”

units.locator: Territorial Planning
units.text: Budget expenditure is aligned with spatial development priorities through up-to-date territorial planning documents, including territorial planning schemes of the Russian Federation in various fields and territorial planning schemes of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, which inform the preparation and adjustment of state programs, investment programs of natural monopolies and other program documents.
units.label: Territorial Planning · “Budget expenditure is aligned with spatial development…”

units.locator: Territorial Planning
units.text: Unified sectoral classifications of facilities of federal and regional significance are used in preparing territorial planning documents.
units.label: Territorial Planning · “Unified sectoral classifications of facilities of federal and…”

units.locator: Territorial Planning
units.text: Financing and commencement of construction of facilities of federal and regional significance must be permitted only where those facilities are included in territorial planning documents at the corresponding level.
units.label: Territorial Planning · “Financing and commencement of construction of facilities of…”

units.text: The Digital Platform
units.label: The Digital Platform

units.locator: The Digital Platform
units.text: The digital foundation for implementing the Strategy is the digital platform, through which the following are carried out:
units.label: The Digital Platform · “The digital foundation for implementing the Strategy is the…”

units.locator: The Digital Platform
units.text: classification of settlements, including determination and updating of the unified list of anchor settlements;
units.label: The Digital Platform · “classification of settlements, including determination and…”
